scope: Renderer-owned read-only visual selection over the existing native-admitted box geometry. Shared author parse/edit APIs, schema, picking helper, math, source host and backend unchanged. Actual browser/GPU shader/pixel verification is separately reported by the parent/UI.

oldAssertionsProof.fixtureOnlyAddition: uniform1i observer for the new per-object bool shader uniform

contract.setter: setSelectedObject(instanceId|null) -> boolean; known loaded stable UUID or null only. Unloaded, unknown, invalid, disposed or context-lost requests are false with prior state unchanged. Same selection returns true without redrawing.
contract.snapshot: selectedInstanceId is UUID|null, a read-only view snapshot field.
contract.lifecycle: setModel clears selected identity before the UI resynchronizes. resetView preserves it. dispose clears it. Setter never emits picks or changes camera/source model.
contract.drawing: One existing TRIANGLES pass per original box, 36 vertices, actual Float32 matrices, original declaration order, depth LEQUAL and no extra geometry or buffers. Object-local flat face axis selects its two varying coordinates, fwidth smooths distance to +/-0.5 boundaries, and a bright outer/dark inner mix distinguishes physical edges from author colors.
contract.tapFrameException: Only the private selection redraw may preserve existing frame identity. It requires exact actual Float32 VP/model payloads (including negative zero), stable source-ordered UUIDs, rounded allocation and CSS width/height, and unchanged actual backing width/height before drawing. Public render remains a new frame.
contract.staleGuard: Changes to model geometry, UUID order, CSS size or the backing buffer revoke old tap eligibility even if selection redraw restores the old allocation. Position-only scrolling still uses current rect; moving a pending gesture/tap cancels it.
contract.normalDoubleClick: Native pointerup-driven capture release followed by the UI selection setter, second tap and double-click retains qualified unchanged-geometry eligibility. Unexpected capture loss and other existing cancellation boundaries continue to revoke it.

limitations: Pixel width is derivative-based and approximate in drawing-buffer pixels; no fixed CSS-pixel outline thickness or cross-device pixel equality is promised.

No inflated geometry, extra wire/line pass, triangle diagonals, x-ray or synthetic near-plane cap is introduced. Hidden selected surfaces retain original depth occlusion and exact-depth later-declaration order.

Unit shader checks inspect the uploaded six-face/12-edge geometry and shader/GL call contract; they do not compile or rasterize the shader on real GPU hardware. Real browser pixel evidence is separate.
buildScope: No Rust/WASM/native compilation or whole-application test was run by this owner; pinned Node focused tests only.
